title: Cartograph plugin release
description: SPECIFIC to the Cartograph agent plugin (cartograph-plugin). How to ship a skill or manifest change as a new 0.1.x: edit canonical skills/, mirror grok and codex copies, bump every host via scripts/versions.py, keep README in lockstep, PR squash-merge to main, copy the skill into the local Grok install. Do not bump cartograph-mcp unless the CLI flags agents actually pass have changed. Does not cover cartograph-cli PyPI.

steps.title: Edit canonical skill only
steps.do: Change skills/<name>/SKILL.md in cartograph-plugin. That file is the source. Do not hand-edit provider copies first. Leave unrelated dirty skills (for example cg-rules WIP) unstaged.

steps.title: Mirror grok and codex copies
steps.do: Copy the canonical SKILL.md to providers/grok/skills/<name>/ and providers/codex/skills/<name>/. Prefer that one-file copy when other skills are dirty. Full `scripts/sync-grok.py` / `scripts/sync-codex.py` rebuilds every skill and would mix WIP. Also copy into ~/.grok/installed-plugins/grok-*/skills/<name>/SKILL.md so the current Grok session sees it.

steps.title: Bump every host together
steps.do: `python3 scripts/versions.py --bump patch` then `python3 scripts/versions.py --check`. That writes Claude, Grok, Grok provider, Codex, Gemini, OpenClaw, and Antigravity. Set README **Version:** to the same number (it has drifted before). Do not bump cartograph-mcp for a skill-only or CLI-default change: agents already omit extra flags.

steps.title: Stage only the release files
steps.do: Add canonical skill, the two provider copies, host manifests, and README. `git status` first: leave other modified skills unstaged. Commit on a feature branch, push, squash-merge the PR to main. Fast-forward the local main checkout after merge.
